The '''Colicoid Stealth-X sniper''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] produced by the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
